items.title: How many engineers does Renata's leadership actually reach?
items.description: Renata directly manages 3 managers. Between them, those managers run 24 engineers — an average of 8 each, the same size as Renata's old team. Every decision she makes as a manager-of-managers reaches this many people indirectly, through a manager's own interpretation, not directly. Drag the number of managers or the average team size to see how fast that indirect reach grows.
items.compute: const indirectReach = params.numManagers * params.avgTeamSize; return { indirectReach };
